metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Shoulder Pain in SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates simple exercises that can quickly relieve shoulder pain and tightness—even in as little as 30 seconds.

These movements help release tension in the shoulder muscles and tendons while improving joint mobility. They can also benefit people dealing with shoulder arthritis by easing stiffness and supporting a better range of motion.

Each exercise works differently, so try them out and stick with the ones that provide the most relief.

Watch now and start easing your shoulder pain in seconds!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:25 Pendulum Swings
2:35 Wall Slides
4:18 Finger Hook
5:57 Angels & Swimmers
8:01 Strengthening Exercise
